      Perfect! - We stayed here for two weeks last August. The room was typically Greek, immaculately clean and the location perfect: very quiet but within easy walking distance of bars, restaurants... read more and the beach. In the middle of the holiday, my husband had a bad fall and needed to go to hospital for treatment. I cannot praises the care and support that was given to us by the owners; it was a frightening time for both of us and they were absolutely wonderful. In the current climate, greatly overshadowed by Covid, these place is worth serious consideration: there are no shared areas such as a bar or pool and each bungalow is , coincidentally, safely distanced from other properties. In fact, I would say it is possibly the safest way to holiday in Greece at the moment. Anyway, on many levels, I would not hesitate to recommend this marvellous place. When you do go, I throughly recommend the short walk to the beach at sunrise: the view as the sun comes over the hills will absolutely take your breath away.

    Gina S
    28th July 2020
